messages.subject: Energy & Sustainability Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Spencer Riley Team,

Your international executive-search coverage across environmental, industrial, energy and renewables markets aligns with my leadership background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where energy transition and industrial growth require regulatory coordination, responsible development and trusted stakeholder relationships. I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
